feeds.title: Tangible Day
feeds.description: This site is dedicated to you, the avid tabletop gamer and miniature hobbyist. Do you love assembling and painting miniatures and models? Awesome! I've been a commissioned miniature painter and hobby modeler for years. Here, you'll find every treasure I've discovered: pro painting tips, tutorials, miniature photography, product reviews, and editorials.

feeds.title: Bird with a Brush Blog
feeds.description: Rhonda Bender, aka Wren the Bard, is a freelance miniature painter and teacher of miniature painting. Follow the blog for articles on miniature painting.

feeds.title: Scar Hand Painting Blog
feeds.description: I'm Maciej and this is my hobby blog. I am a passionate hobbyist bringing miniatures and models to life since 1996'. I sincerely hope to bring life to yet more miniatures with Miniature Commission Painting. In the meantime, I try both to share my experience through Painting Tutorials and to learn from awesome painters present on the web.

feeds.title: The Brush and Boltgun
feeds.description: A wargaming, hobby and painting blog. Creating step by step painting video tutorials for tabletop miniatures. Get your miniatures looking great on the tabletop.

feeds.title: K.C. Holt Miniature Painting Blog
feeds.description: K.C. Holt is an award winning professional painter and teacher with 30 years of painting experience. He works with both private clients and retail business customers. He has painted models for in-store demonstration games and displays pieces for widely known gaming companies, such as Games Workshop and Fantasy Flight Games.

feeds.title: Heresy Brush
feeds.description: My name is Rubén Torregrosa. I created this blog in September 2008. Initially, I used it as a 'painting journal' to remember what I was working on at the time and what paints or techniques I used for this or that. However, little by little I began to focus more on creating painting guides and tutorials. So far, I've tried to share everything I've learned at my painting table.

feeds.title: Sproket's Small World Blog
feeds.description: A blog about miniature painting by David Soper. David is a retired Graphic Designer and Illustrator who is now a full time hobbyist.

feeds.title: Just Add Water
feeds.description: A miniature painting and wargaming blog.

feeds.title: Tale of Painters
feeds.description: Tale of Painter is an unofficial Warhammer hobby magazine and painting blog. Since 2011, we bring you free tutorials, in-depth reviews, and stunning pictures of our painted miniatures for your inspiration. The works of our contributors have been featured in White Dwarf, Warhammer Visions, and on Warhammer Community numerous times.

feeds.title: Lair of the Lagomorph Blog
feeds.description: This blog is a place for me to share my miniature painting projects. Its primary purpose is a historical record of what I've painted for myself, so I can look up old recipes if I need to match an army scheme in the future, but hopefully, if someone else stumbles in on it it can provide some inspiration.

feeds.title: MASSIVE VOODOO Blog
feeds.description: Welcome to the jungle of daily miniature painting inspiration! MASSIVE VOODOO's jungle, where some apes share their thoughts and ideas around their beloved passion, the hobby of miniature painting and sculpting.

feeds.title: Borgnine's Miniature Painting
feeds.description: A blog about painting and converting wargaming miniatures for WFB, AoS, Blood Bowl, Warhammer Underworlds, and other systems.

feeds.title: Musk's Miniatures
feeds.description: Models and Miniatures by Muskie McKay. I've been painting miniatures for a long time, most famously Nurgle miniatures. Though I took an extended hiatus due to difficulties with my life and career. I've finally gotten my paints and models out of storage and will try to make progress on my many neglected hobby goals.

feeds.title: OrkAngel Blog » Miniature Painting
feeds.description: This blog is about my adventures in wargaming, miniature painting, and RPG.

feeds.title: From the Lands and from the Landsknecht
feeds.description: A Miniature (Painting) Blog. Find articles on miniature painting.

feeds.title: Tiffany Hastie Art Blog
feeds.description: Adventures in Art and Miniature Paintings. Tiffany is a member of MPSGS (Miniature Painters, Sculptors and Gravers Society of Washington DC), an author of two painting books (Endless Seasons Vol. I & II, Scheewe Publications Inc.), and an artist working in painting, drawing, and design.

feeds.title: Mengel Miniatures
feeds.description: Your top site for hobby content including interviews, tutorials, reviews, showcases & more. Contributor to the Warhammer Community site.

feeds.title: Drunken Samurai Painting Blog
feeds.description: Articles on samurai painting and wargaming by Robert.

feeds.title: Chest of Colors
feeds.description: Chest of Colors is one of the largest miniature painting communities online. What we all have in common is that we are fans of painted miniatures!

feeds.title: Creative Twilight
feeds.description: Blog dedicated to all things creative; be it miniature painting, blacksmithing, or woodworking. You can find a bit of everything here including tutorials, guides, and reviews.
